name: @socialmorning/api
description: The social layer's HTTP API (specs/002-m3-social-layer/contracts/api.md). Hono on Node; one Vercel function in production, @hono/node-server locally.

scripts.build: esbuild src/vercel-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --loader:.wasm=binary --loader:.woff=binary --outfile=api/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
